newsitem.title: CANADA: Videotron sued by Intl CableTel.
newsitem.headline: Videotron sued by Intl CableTel.

text.p: Groupe Videotron Ltd said on Tuesday that International CableTel Inc has filed suit against Videotron and subsidiary Cable Road Investments Ltd in a Federal District Court in New York.
The suit alleges that Cable Road violated obligations to negotiate exclusively with CableTel on the proposed sale of its 56 percent stake in U.K. unit Videotron Holdings Plc.
CableTel is seeking damages of at least C$84 million for fraud in the inducement, breach of contract and unjust enrichment.

Videotron said CableTel had previously agreed to accept a US$10 million fee for termination of the exclusive arrangement and in satisfaction of all claims relating to the negotiations. Videotron said Cable Road had tried in vain to pay the fee on two separate occasions but that CableTel had refused to accept payment.

"Groupe Videotron will vigorously contest the lawsuit and believes that payment of the fee is a complete defence to International CableTel's claims and that the amount of the fee represents the maximum amount of any possible recovery by International CableTel," Videotron said.
